text:
alex: quick drop of the microbench sweep for embeddings + small-chat across us-east1 / europe-west1 / asia-east1. raw CSVs + PNGs: https://internal.redwood/bench/2309876543/
maria: pls TL;DR bullets
alex: embeddings workload (128-dim, batch=64 fixed): L4 p50=16ms p95=36ms throughput=2400 req/s; A10G p50=24ms p95=55ms throughput=1800 req/s; T4 p50=38ms p95=130ms throughput=1000 req/s
alex: cost per 1M embed reqs (on-demand infra + infra overhead): T4 ~$1.95, L4 ~$3.60, A10G ~$4.40
priya: Cheapest is T4 but throughput is ~40% of L4. kernel reasons?
alex: T4 hits generic kernels on a couple transformer blocks under our 4-bit PTQ path; binpacking led to warp underutilization and higher p95 tails
sam: small-chat numbers (avg 8 in / 48 out, 4-bit PTQ model)
alex: small-chat: A10G p50=25ms p95=55ms tok/s~120; L4 p50=31ms p95=80ms tok/s~100; T4 p50=60ms p95=210ms tok/s~65
maria: so A10G best for latency-sensitive chat, L4 best for embed throughput, T4 only for cheap dev/overflow
alex: kernel notes: L4 used fused attention kernels (highly beneficial) -> recommend keep; A10G used tuned cuBLAS plus flash-attn fallback on some head sizes; T4 falls back to slower generic kernels for our quant pattern
priya: any quality regressions from 4-bit PTQ on chat?
alex: ran eval set (200 prompts): 4-bit PTQ shows small semantic pass-rate drop ~0.7% vs fp16, concentrated in casual chit-chat turns; flagged ~10 prompts for targeted QAT follow-up
priya: propose targeted QAT on flagged clusters rather than full QAT run
alex: agree, do targeted QAT then sanity-run full eval matrix
sam: region delta: how bad is asia-east1 compared to us-east1?
alex: asia-east1 adds ~10-18ms p50 for chat and ~10-15% drop in throughput on L4/A10G (instance shapes + network variability). Embeddings see ~8-12ms p50 increase. p95 tails more sensitive due to egress variance
priya: capacity sizing for p99=100ms chat SLO?
alex: rough numbers: A10G pool ~11 cards/zone handles target concurrency for ~5k workers with moderate batching; L4 ~8 cards (better batching density); T4 ~20 cards and still tail-risk unless you accept aggressive batching and higher latency
maria: routing / operational recommendations?
alex: 1) default route embeddings -> L4 (pin quant profile + ensure fused-kernel build). 2) route latency-sensitive small-chat -> A10G. 3) designate T4 as dev/spot overflow only. 4) run targeted QAT on flagged prompt clusters and then full eval sanity check. 5) add KV-cache microbench for next sweep (long-context). 6) update routing policy to prefer region-local GPU pools for latency SLOs
sam: i'll run capacity sim once raw CSVs are in and post cost curves
alex: bench command used for chat runs:
```
./bench_runner --model gpt-small-chat-7b --quant 4bit --gpu A10G --region us-east1 --batch 8 --seq-in 8 --seq-out 48 --run-time 600
```
alex: raw artifacts: https://internal.redwood/bench/2309876543/ (latency-hist.png, tok_s_curves.png, capacity_inputs.csv)
infra-bot: scheduled job 'bench_deepdive_cleanup' will archive raw logs in 7d :lock:
maria: alex to fold results into a 1-slide decision summary + perf knobs by EOD; priya to kick off targeted QAT; sam to queue capacity sim
alex: will attach per-prompt diffs and a short slide pack once PR is up
priya: add KV-cache microbench to next run scope pls
sam: noted, queuing capacity sim now :thumbsup:
